errors.description: endpoint_data_q is a multi-bit value produced in usb_clk and sampled directly in sys_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
token_pulse_q is a one-cycle usb_clk pulse consumed directly in sys_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
token_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample sys_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in sys_event_o.
ep_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector ep_mode_q before decoding in sys_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
usb_rst_n is used as data inside sys_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
debug_snapshot_q combines usb_clk payload state with sys_clk status state in debug_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
